notes.title: GAME UPDATE: Slaying Crushers & Robot Puppies has become even more epic
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/LvTk36YkKdkcpmEhAj/giphy.gif[/img]

Hello Saviours of Humanity,

We're really excited to share that we have released a new build for Rise of Humanity: Prologue with some surprise updates!

[list]
[*] The attacks have new special effects so your battles against Crushers and robot Puppies will be even more epic
[*] New cutscenes that show off the stunning scenery of the game
[/list]

We also made bug fixes based on your feedback and suggestions, many thanks for sharing these, they are incredibly helpful for us!

Let us know what you think in the comments or the reviews!

notes.title: Update notes for July 7th
notes.notes:
Hello saviors of humanity,

We have just put a build live with the following fixes:

[list]
[*] We enlarged the cards in hand so the Asian fonts are more readable.
[*] We also changed the Russian font to make it more readable.
[*] We fixed a bug with the skills in the second mission. It was possible to crash part of the game if you activated the skill and ended your turn. We have also darkened the screen so it is more clear the skill is active.
[/list]

Enjoy and happy crusher hunting!
